env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC 0.3: an ejected package keeps only the imports its text uses, so a
# union term that was the last use of an import does not break the build.
cd w
logos run .
stdout '^plain$'
stdout '^dot$'
stdout '^alias$'
stdout '^blank$'
stdout '^lib$'
stdout '^used 1$'
stdout '^dotjson m\.A$'
stdout '^dotjson m\.B$'
stdout '^nest m\.A$'
stdout '^nest nest\.C$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt

logos eject -o $WORK/out
cd $WORK/out
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- w/go.mod --
module example.com/ej

go 1.27

-- w/m/m.lgo --
package m

type A struct {
	X int64 `json:"x"`
}

type B struct {
	Y string `json:"y"`
}

-- w/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

import "example.com/ej/m"

type U interface {
	m.A | m.B
}

func Make() U {
	return nil
}

-- w/plain/plain.lgo --
package plain

import "example.com/ej/m"

type U interface {
	m.A | m.B
}

func Show() string {
	var u U
	if u == nil {
		return "plain"
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/dotp/dotp.lgo --
package dotp

import . "example.com/ej/m"

type U interface {
	A | B
}

func Show() string {
	var u U
	if u == nil {
		return "dot"
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/aliasp/aliasp.lgo --
package aliasp

import mm "example.com/ej/m"

type U interface {
	mm.A | mm.B
}

func Show() string {
	var u U
	if u == nil {
		return "alias"
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/blankp/blankp.lgo --
package blankp

import (
	"example.com/ej/lib"
	_ "example.com/ej/m"
)

func Show() string {
	u := lib.Make()
	if u == nil {
		return "blank"
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/usedp/usedp.lgo --
package usedp

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ej/m"
)

type U interface {
	m.A | m.B
}

func Show() string {
	var u U = m.A{X: 1}
	if a, ok := u.(m.A); ok {
		return fmt.Sprint("used ", a.X)
	}
	return "other"
}

-- w/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ej/aliasp"
	"example.com/ej/blankp"
	"example.com/ej/dotp"
	"example.com/ej/dotjson"
	"example.com/ej/lib"
	"example.com/ej/nest"
	"example.com/ej/plain"
	"example.com/ej/usedp"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(plain.Show())
	fmt.Println(dotp.Show())
	fmt.Println(aliasp.Show())
	fmt.Println(blankp.Show())
	if lib.Make() == nil {
		fmt.Println("lib")
	}
	for _, line := range dotjson.Show() {
		fmt.Println(line)
	}
	for _, line := range nest.Show() {
		fmt.Println(line)
	}
	fmt.Println(usedp.Show())
}

-- w/dotjson/dotjson.lgo --
package dotjson

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	. "example.com/ej/m"
)

type N interface {
	A | B
}

type H struct {
	V N `json:"v"`
}

func Show() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, in := range []string{`{"v":{"x":1}}`, `{"v":{"y":"b"}}`} {
		var h H
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &h); err != nil {
			return []string{err.Error()}
		}
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("dotjson %T", h.V))
	}
	return out
}

-- w/nest/nest.lgo --
package nest

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"

	"example.com/ej/lib"
)

type C struct {
	Z int64 `json:"z"`
}

type V interface {
	lib.U | C
}

type H struct {
	V V `json:"v"`
}

func Show() []string {
	var out []string
	for _, in := range []string{`{"v":{"x":1}}`, `{"v":{"z":2}}`} {
		var h H
		if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(in), &h); err != nil {
			return []string{err.Error()}
		}
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("nest %T", h.V))
	}
	return out
}
